    pass

    # Pattern alignment per plan-review F3: do NOT invent a new write path.

    # Returns True if .reconciler-phase-gate exists on tickets AND target_mode rank > gated_mode rank

## Failure-mode discipline (plan-review F3 + F7)
- Missing tickets branch: fail-CLOSED with ReconcileLockError. Rationale: silent fail-open would disable dd-3 concurrency protection.
- Tickets-branch writes: MUST use _concurrency.rebase_retry — the existing serialization-safe pattern. Naive 'git commit && git push' races with concurrent passes.
- Audit-log noise: 2 commits per pass (acquire + release) is acceptable; these commits are operator-visible signals of pass start/stop. Document in T5.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body:
AC amendment (gap G4): git show exit-code discrimination. `git show tickets:.reconciler-pass-lock` returns exit 128 for BOTH (a) 'unknown revision: tickets' (branch missing — fail-CLOSED) AND (b) 'path X does not exist in tickets' (lock file absent on branch — normal acquire path). Discriminate via STDERR substring match:
- stderr contains 'unknown revision' → raise ReconcileLockError (fail-CLOSED)
- stderr contains 'does not exist in' → return False (no lock)
- exit 0 (file present) → return True (locked)
- any other non-zero with unrecognized stderr → raise ReconcileLockError (fail-CLOSED)
Add tests for ALL three stderr cases. Without this, fail-CLOSED collapses with 'no lock file' and disables concurrency protection silently.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap G5): release_pass_lock ownership check. The lock file contains pass_id + timestamp_ns (per T2 spec). release_pass_lock MUST read the existing lock contents and verify the pass_id matches the releasing process's pass_id BEFORE deletion. On mismatch: log warning + leave file in place + return without raising (defensive — don't unlock another process). Without owner-check, parallel passes can mutually unlock each other. Add test: acquire with pass_id=X, attempt release with pass_id=Y → file remains, warning logged.
